# Skills

Instructions for an agent that changes a skill in this directory.

- Before you change a skill, read its `README.md`, when it has one, and [skill-writing.md](../rules/skill-writing.md).
- Make every change that the README's When the Skill Is Changed section names, in the same run, and run the checks it lists before you call the change done.

A skill's `SKILL.md` does not link to its `README.md`, so that no run of the skill loads it: this file is how an agent that changes the skill finds it.
